projectCategory: Project Pattern: 30 Comprehensive C ASCII Graphic & Numerical Pattern Projects
subject: C Programming Language (ANSI C / C99)
class: Computer Science Core / BCA / B.Tech / ICSE / Competitive Coding

projects.title: Right-Angled Star Triangle Pattern
projects.description: Print a right-angled triangle of stars with N rows where row r contains r stars.
projects.learningOutcome: Nested Loops, 2D Spatial Coordinate Mapping, Boundary Evaluation & Formatting
projects.logicExplanation: Outer loop r runs 1..N. Inner loop c runs 1..r printing '* '.
projects.codeExplanation: Uses nested outer row (r) and inner column (c) loops to render procedural ASCII graphics.

projects.title: Inverted Right-Angled Star Triangle Pattern
projects.description: Print an inverted right-angled triangle where row 1 has N stars decreasing down to 1 star.
projects.learningOutcome: Nested Loops, 2D Spatial Coordinate Mapping, Boundary Evaluation & Formatting
projects.logicExplanation: Outer loop r runs N down to 1. Inner loop c runs 1..r printing '* '.
projects.codeExplanation: Uses nested outer row (r) and inner column (c) loops to render procedural ASCII graphics.

projects.title: Right-Aligned Star Triangle Pattern
projects.description: Print a right-aligned right-angled triangle with leading spaces.
projects.learningOutcome: Nested Loops, 2D Spatial Coordinate Mapping, Boundary Evaluation & Formatting
projects.exampleText: Row r has (N-r)*2 leading spaces followed by r stars.
projects.logicExplanation: Outer loop r runs 1..N. First inner loop prints (N-r)*2 spaces; second inner loop prints '* '.
projects.codeExplanation: Uses nested outer row (r) and inner column (c) loops to render procedural ASCII graphics.

projects.title: Inverted Right-Aligned Star Triangle Pattern
projects.description: Print an inverted right-aligned triangle of stars.
projects.learningOutcome: Nested Loops, 2D Spatial Coordinate Mapping, Boundary Evaluation & Formatting
projects.exampleText: Row r (N down to 1) has (N-r)*2 leading spaces followed by r stars.
projects.logicExplanation: Outer loop r runs N down to 1. Space loop prints (N-r)*2 spaces; star loop prints '* '.
projects.codeExplanation: Uses nested outer row (r) and inner column (c) loops to render procedural ASCII graphics.

projects.title: Centered Full Isosceles Star Pyramid
projects.description: Print a centered pyramid of stars with N rows where row r has N-r spaces and 2r-1 stars.
projects.learningOutcome: Nested Loops, 2D Spatial Coordinate Mapping, Boundary Evaluation & Formatting
projects.exampleText: Row 1: 1 star, Row 2: 3 stars, Row 3: 5 stars...
projects.logicExplanation: Outer loop r=1..N. Space loop runs 1..N-r printing ' '. Star loop runs 1..2*r-1 printing '*'.
projects.codeExplanation: Uses nested outer row (r) and inner column (c) loops to render procedural ASCII graphics.

projects.title: Inverted Centered Star Pyramid
projects.description: Print an inverted centered star pyramid of N rows.
projects.learningOutcome: Nested Loops, 2D Spatial Coordinate Mapping, Boundary Evaluation & Formatting
projects.exampleText: Row r=N..1 has N-r spaces and 2r-1 stars.
projects.logicExplanation: Outer loop r=N down to 1. Space loop runs 1..N-r printing ' '. Star loop runs 1..2*r-1 printing '*'.
projects.codeExplanation: Uses nested outer row (r) and inner column (c) loops to render procedural ASCII graphics.

projects.title: Full Symmetrical Star Diamond Pattern
projects.description: Combine an upright star pyramid and an inverted star pyramid into a symmetrical diamond.
projects.learningOutcome: Nested Loops, 2D Spatial Coordinate Mapping, Boundary Evaluation & Formatting
projects.exampleText: Upper half N rows, lower half N-1 rows.
projects.logicExplanation: Run upright pyramid loop 1..N, then run inverted pyramid loop N-1 down to 1.
projects.codeExplanation: Uses nested outer row (r) and inner column (c) loops to render procedural ASCII graphics.

projects.title: Hollow Star Square Pattern (N x N)
projects.description: Print an N x N square with stars on the boundary and empty spaces inside.
projects.learningOutcome: Nested Loops, 2D Spatial Coordinate Mapping, Boundary Evaluation & Formatting
projects.exampleText: Stars printed if r==1, r==N, c==1, or c==N.
projects.logicExplanation: If r==1 || r==N || c==1 || c==N print '* ', else print two spaces '  '.
projects.codeExplanation: Uses nested outer row (r) and inner column (c) loops to render procedural ASCII graphics.

projects.title: Hollow Star Pyramid Pattern
projects.description: Print a centered star pyramid with stars only on the outline border.
projects.learningOutcome: Nested Loops, 2D Spatial Coordinate Mapping, Boundary Evaluation & Formatting
projects.exampleText: Stars at start of pyramid line, end of line, or bottom row.
projects.logicExplanation: For row r, print star if k==1, k==2*r-1, or r==N.
projects.codeExplanation: Uses nested outer row (r) and inner column (c) loops to render procedural ASCII graphics.

projects.title: Hollow Star Diamond Pattern
projects.description: Print a symmetrical diamond with stars only along its perimeter.
projects.learningOutcome: Nested Loops, 2D Spatial Coordinate Mapping, Boundary Evaluation & Formatting
projects.exampleText: Hollow diamond perimeter.
projects.logicExplanation: Print star at perimeter positions (k==1 or k==2*r-1) for upper and lower halves.
projects.codeExplanation: Uses nested outer row (r) and inner column (c) loops to render procedural ASCII graphics.

projects.title: Half Diamond Star Pattern
projects.description: Print a right-pointing half diamond pattern.
projects.learningOutcome: Nested Loops, 2D Spatial Coordinate Mapping, Boundary Evaluation & Formatting
projects.exampleText: Increases to N stars then decreases.
projects.logicExplanation: Loop r=1..N printing r stars; then loop r=N-1 down to 1 printing r stars.
projects.codeExplanation: Uses nested outer row (r) and inner column (c) loops to render procedural ASCII graphics.

projects.title: Left-Pointing Half Diamond Star Pattern
projects.description: Print a left-pointing half diamond pattern with leading spaces.
projects.learningOutcome: Nested Loops, 2D Spatial Coordinate Mapping, Boundary Evaluation & Formatting
projects.exampleText: Left-pointing half diamond.
projects.logicExplanation: Upper half space loop (N-r)*2, star loop r; lower half space loop (N-r)*2, star loop r.
projects.codeExplanation: Uses nested outer row (r) and inner column (c) loops to render procedural ASCII graphics.

projects.title: Hourglass Star Pattern
projects.description: Print an hourglass pattern combining inverted pyramid and upright pyramid.
projects.learningOutcome: Nested Loops, 2D Spatial Coordinate Mapping, Boundary Evaluation & Formatting
projects.exampleText: Top pyramid wide, middle narrow, bottom wide.
projects.logicExplanation: Run inverted pyramid r=N down to 1, then upright pyramid r=2..N.
projects.codeExplanation: Uses nested outer row (r) and inner column (c) loops to render procedural ASCII graphics.

projects.title: Butterfly Star Pattern
projects.description: Print a symmetrical butterfly pattern of stars.
projects.learningOutcome: Nested Loops, 2D Spatial Coordinate Mapping, Boundary Evaluation & Formatting
projects.exampleText: Left and right wings meeting in middle.
projects.logicExplanation: For row r=1..N, print r stars, 2*(N-r) spaces, r stars. Mirror for lower half.
projects.codeExplanation: Uses nested outer row (r) and inner column (c) loops to render procedural ASCII graphics.

projects.title: Right-Angled Number Triangle (1 to r per row)
projects.description: Print numbers 1 to r on each row r.
projects.learningOutcome: Nested Loops, 2D Spatial Coordinate Mapping, Boundary Evaluation & Formatting
projects.logicExplanation: Outer r=1..N, inner c=1..r printing c.
projects.codeExplanation: Uses nested outer row (r) and inner column (c) loops to render procedural ASCII graphics.

projects.title: Right-Angled Constant Number Triangle (r per row)
projects.description: Print number r repeated r times on row r.
projects.learningOutcome: Nested Loops, 2D Spatial Coordinate Mapping, Boundary Evaluation & Formatting
projects.logicExplanation: Outer r=1..N, inner c=1..r printing r.
projects.codeExplanation: Uses nested outer row (r) and inner column (c) loops to render procedural ASCII graphics.

projects.title: Floyd's Triangle of Natural Numbers
projects.description: Print consecutive natural numbers in a right-angled triangle.
projects.learningOutcome: Nested Loops, 2D Spatial Coordinate Mapping, Boundary Evaluation & Formatting
projects.logicExplanation: Maintain global counter num=1. Outer r=1..N, inner c=1..r printing num++.
projects.codeExplanation: Uses nested outer row (r) and inner column (c) loops to render procedural ASCII graphics.

projects.title: Inverted Number Triangle Pattern
projects.description: Print an inverted triangle of numbers 1 to r.
projects.learningOutcome: Nested Loops, 2D Spatial Coordinate Mapping, Boundary Evaluation & Formatting
projects.logicExplanation: Outer r=N down to 1, inner c=1..r printing c.
projects.codeExplanation: Uses nested outer row (r) and inner column (c) loops to render procedural ASCII graphics.

projects.title: Binary 0-1 Alternating Triangle Pattern
projects.description: Print 1s and 0s alternating in a right-angled triangle.
projects.learningOutcome: Nested Loops, 2D Spatial Coordinate Mapping, Boundary Evaluation & Formatting
projects.exampleText: Starts 1 if (r+c) is even, 0 if odd.
projects.logicExplanation: If (r + c) % 2 == 0 print 1, else print 0.
projects.codeExplanation: Uses nested outer row (r) and inner column (c) loops to render procedural ASCII graphics.

projects.title: Centered Number Pyramid (1 to r and Back)
projects.description: Print a palindrome number pyramid on each row with exact spatial centering.
projects.learningOutcome: Nested Loops, 2D Spatial Coordinate Mapping, Boundary Evaluation & Formatting
projects.logicExplanation: Space loop runs (N - r) * 2 spaces; inner loop 1..r prints 'c '; second inner loop r-1 down to 1 prints 'c '.
projects.codeExplanation: Uses nested outer row (r) and inner column (c) loops to render procedural ASCII graphics.

projects.title: Pascal's Triangle of Binomial Coefficients
projects.description: Print Pascal's Triangle using combination formulas.
projects.learningOutcome: Nested Loops, 2D Spatial Coordinate Mapping, Boundary Evaluation & Formatting
projects.exampleText: Each number is sum of two numbers above.
projects.logicExplanation: Use iterative binomial combination `val = val * (n - k) / (k + 1)`.
projects.codeExplanation: Uses nested outer row (r) and inner column (c) loops to render procedural ASCII graphics.

projects.title: Continuous Increasing Number Square (N x N)
projects.description: Print a square matrix filled with consecutive numbers 1 to N^2.
projects.learningOutcome: Nested Loops, 2D Spatial Coordinate Mapping, Boundary Evaluation & Formatting
projects.exampleText: 1 to 16 for 4x4 matrix.
projects.logicExplanation: Maintain num=1; outer r=1..N, inner c=1..N printing num++ with %3d formatting.
projects.codeExplanation: Uses nested outer row (r) and inner column (c) loops to render procedural ASCII graphics.

projects.title: Right-Angled Alphabet Triangle (A to Z)
projects.description: Print uppercase alphabetic letters in a right-angled triangle.
projects.learningOutcome: Nested Loops, 2D Spatial Coordinate Mapping, Boundary Evaluation & Formatting
projects.exampleText: Row 1: A, Row 2: A B, Row 3: A B C...
projects.exampleOutput:
A
A B
A B C
A B C D
A B C D E
projects.logicExplanation: Outer r=1..N, inner c=0..r-1 printing (char)('A' + c).
projects.codeExplanation: Uses nested outer row (r) and inner column (c) loops to render procedural ASCII graphics.

projects.title: Palindromic Character Pyramid Pattern
projects.description: Print a centered pyramid of palindromic letters.
projects.learningOutcome: Nested Loops, 2D Spatial Coordinate Mapping, Boundary Evaluation & Formatting
projects.exampleText: Row 1: A, Row 2: A B A, Row 3: A B C B A...
projects.exampleOutput:
A
      A B A
    A B C B A
  A B C D C B A
A B C D E D C B A
projects.logicExplanation: Space loop (N - r) * 2; char loop 'A'..'A'+r-1; backward char loop 'A'+r-2 down to 'A'.
projects.codeExplanation: Uses nested outer row (r) and inner column (c) loops to render procedural ASCII graphics.

projects.title: Inverted Character Triangle Pattern
projects.description: Print an inverted triangle of letters.
projects.learningOutcome: Nested Loops, 2D Spatial Coordinate Mapping, Boundary Evaluation & Formatting
projects.exampleText: Row 1: A B C D E, Row 2: A B C D...
projects.exampleOutput:
A B C D E
A B C D
A B C
A B
A
projects.logicExplanation: Outer r=N down to 1, inner c=0..r-1 printing (char)('A' + c).
projects.codeExplanation: Uses nested outer row (r) and inner column (c) loops to render procedural ASCII graphics.

projects.title: 2D Checkerboard / Chessboard Grid Pattern
projects.description: Print alternating 'B' (Black) and 'W' (White) cells in an N x N grid.
projects.learningOutcome: Nested Loops, 2D Spatial Coordinate Mapping, Boundary Evaluation & Formatting
projects.exampleText: Alternating grid.
projects.exampleOutput:
W B W B W
B W B W B
W B W B W
B W B W B
W B W B W
projects.logicExplanation: If (r + c) % 2 == 0 print 'W ', else print 'B '.
projects.codeExplanation: Uses nested outer row (r) and inner column (c) loops to render procedural ASCII graphics.

projects.title: X-Shape Cross Pattern of Stars
projects.description: Print an X-shaped cross of stars inside an N x N square.
projects.learningOutcome: Nested Loops, 2D Spatial Coordinate Mapping, Boundary Evaluation & Formatting
projects.exampleText: Stars on main and anti-diagonals.
projects.logicExplanation: If r == c || r + c == N + 1 print '* ', else print two spaces '  '.
projects.codeExplanation: Uses nested outer row (r) and inner column (c) loops to render procedural ASCII graphics.

projects.title: Plus (+)-Shape Cross Pattern of Stars
projects.description: Print a (+)-shaped cross of stars intersecting at the middle row and column.
projects.learningOutcome: Nested Loops, 2D Spatial Coordinate Mapping, Boundary Evaluation & Formatting
projects.exampleText: Stars on middle row and middle column.
projects.logicExplanation: If r == (N+1)/2 || c == (N+1)/2 print '* ', else print two spaces '  '.
projects.codeExplanation: Uses nested outer row (r) and inner column (c) loops to render procedural ASCII graphics.

projects.title: Concentric Number Box Pattern (Spiralling Outer to Inner)
projects.description: Print concentric square layers of numbers decreasing toward center.
projects.learningOutcome: Nested Loops, 2D Spatial Coordinate Mapping, Boundary Evaluation & Formatting
projects.exampleText: Concentric layers 3 3 3 / 3 2 3 / 3 3 3.
projects.logicExplanation: Find minimum distance to any 4 borders: min(r, c, 2N-r, 2N-c).
projects.codeExplanation: Uses nested outer row (r) and inner column (c) loops to render procedural ASCII graphics.

projects.title: Snake / Zig-Zag Matrix Number Pattern
projects.description: Print consecutive numbers in a snake (zig-zag) row direction.
projects.learningOutcome: Nested Loops, 2D Spatial Coordinate Mapping, Boundary Evaluation & Formatting
projects.exampleText: Odd rows left-to-right, even rows right-to-left.
projects.logicExplanation: If row r is odd, print numbers increasing; if row r is even, print numbers decreasing.
projects.codeExplanation: Uses nested outer row (r) and inner column (c) loops to render procedural ASCII graphics.
